theme: Morytania nights, cursed loot, and controlled chaos
scoring_notes: Use the early_to_mid_game and late_to_end_game entries as tiered tiles rather than requiring every player to attempt every boss.
For shared drops, record the player who received the drop and award the team tile only once unless your clan agrees otherwise.
Treat dynamic_challenges as optional bonus tiles and agree on proof before the event begins.

early_to_mid_game.spooky_vibe: Graverobbing undead wights in a misty Morytania crypt.
A voice-stealing nightmare hiding beneath the haunted ruins of Stranglewood.
Infestations of giant vermin in pitch-black sewers and tunnels.
A cursed scholar driven mad by ancient ruins in the desolate Wilderness.
Subterranean giants living in mossy, damp, claustrophobic dungeons.
Deep, pitch-black water caves teeming with ancient, mutated sea beasts.
Entering a dark, swarming hive to fight a skittering insect that resurrects into a flying nightmare.
A massive, purple demonic entity summoned deep within the dark, crystalline Catacombs of Kourend.
Escorting vulnerable citizens through the mist-shrouded swamps of Morytania while fighting off bloodsucking fiends.

target_requirements: 1 rare reward from the clue reward table
early_to_mid_game.spooky_vibe: A classic fantasy horror trope—a seemingly innocent treasure chest that sprouts teeth and tries to eat you alive.
A crazed, shouting occultist wandering the bleak, dangerous ruins of the Wilderness.

late_to_end_game.spooky_vibe: Fighting a parasitic dream demon in a secluded Morytania town.
Vampyres, rivers of blood, human experimentation, and arachnids.
Creepy flesh-tentacles and Eldritch horrors from the Abyss.
The three-headed hound of hell guarding the underworld.
A blood-thirsty, blind executioner trapped in an infected, bleeding forest.
A giant, decaying, gluttonous demon sleeping in frozen, forgotten catacombs.
Delving deep into a web-choked nest to face a colossal, venom-spitting arachnid.
Trapped in a glowing, eerie digital purgatory against a terrifying, wolf-like crystalline entity.
A ghostly, crimson-glowing spectral beast trapped in an ever-shifting labyrinth that tests your sanity.
Delving into ancient catacombs filled with skeletal mutations, parasitic wasps, and dark sacrificial altars.
A giant, venomous swamp serpent worshipped by an eerie, isolated cult that sacrifices outsiders to it.
An enormous, towering demon of destruction wielding burning cleavers in a frozen underworld pocket dimension.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Stronghold of Security
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Obtain a Skull sceptre from the Stronghold of Security.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Halloween event / Skeleton outfit
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Complete the Halloween Holiday Event, or equip 1 full Skeleton outfit and earn 1 qualifying drop.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Phantom Muspah
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Obtain one of the rare drops from Phantom Muspah.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Sarachnis
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Defeat Sarachnis and obtain 1 Sarachnis cudgel

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Mort'ton pyre ships / shades
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Cremate 25 shades in Mort'ton, or burn 25 Chewed bones to send their spirits onward.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Revenants
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Obtain 1 Ancient Emblem, 1 Ancient Totem, or 1 Ancient Statuette from the Revenants.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Chaos Altar
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Offer 100 dragon bones or better at the Chaos Altar.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Gold Shade Chest
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Open a Gold Shade Chest using a gold key in the creepy, infected town of Morytania.

sub_goals_and_skilling.subtitle: Death's Office
sub_goals_and_skilling.challenge: Teleport to Death's Office and successfully claim a Grave / Death reclaim while wearing a black cape.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Barrows
dynamic_challenges.rule: As a team, complete 10 Barrows chests with no equipped weapons. Barrows damage may come from spells, prayers, or fists.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Wilderness boss trip
dynamic_challenges.rule: Complete a team Wilderness boss trip with every participant wearing at least one Ghostly robe piece.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Boss / raid unique drop
dynamic_challenges.rule: Award a bonus point for a unique or pet received between 12:00 AM and 1:00 AM local time. Record the game clock and screenshot.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Pest Control / raid room
dynamic_challenges.rule: Win a Pest Control game while every participant wears a zombie-themed outfit, or complete a raid room with everyone poisoned at the finish.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Barrows / raid room
dynamic_challenges.rule: Complete a Barrows chest or raid room while every participant wears a visible skeleton-themed item.

dynamic_challenges.subtitle: Wilderness boss
dynamic_challenges.rule: Defeat a Wilderness boss while every participant uses the Arceuus spellbook and summons a thrall during the kill.

description: Optional bonus items with a dark, undead, or demonic aesthetic for extra points.

items.spooky_lore: A corrupted, ancient staff used by the dead brothers to cast malevolent shadow spells.
A sinister, purple staff required to channel the dark magic of the Ancient Magicks spellbook.
A literal ritual icon used to open dark portals to demonic pocket dimensions.

items.item_name: Bandos chestplate / Bandos tassets / Bandos godsword
items.spooky_lore: War trophies taken from the hulking general of Bandos and his brutal God Wars camp.
A terrifying, blood-fueled staff that siphons life force from your targets to heal you.
A weapon pieced together from the organic, pulsing limbs and spinal columns of an Eldritch horror.
Pulsing cores of pure magical energy used to empower raw nightmare curses.

items.item_name: Venator vestige / Leviathan's lure / Virtus mask
items.spooky_lore: A cursed trophy taken from the abyssal sea monster lurking beneath the desert sands.
A terrifying, witch-doctor style tribal mask housing dark defensive spirits.

items.item_name: Granite hammer / Black tourmaline core / Granite ring / Guardian boots
items.spooky_lore: Dusk and Dawn, the twin gargoyles guarding the haunted rooftop of Slayer Tower.

items.item_name: Soulflame horn / Oathplate armour / Yama dossier
items.spooky_lore: A demonic master of pacts waiting beneath the Chasm of Fire.

items.item_name: Elder venator fang / Crimson kisten / Maggot marquess
items.spooky_lore: A parasitic horror wearing the corpse of a powerful vampyric hunter.
A broken golem angel haunting the cathedral of Ardeaglais.

items.item_name: Tumeken's shadow / Osmumten's fang / Masori armour
items.spooky_lore: A cursed desert tomb filled with ancient guardians, scarabs, and the wrath of a forgotten god.
